messages:
Asha (marketing): Quick brainstorm — tightening the battlecard claims for the webinar + inbound routing. Need two short variants: 'econ-first' (cost/efficiency) and 'ops-first' (latency/reliability). Keep each to 2–3 bullets. Thoughts?
Ben (growth): Love that split. For econ-first we should lead with batching + caching numbers and a simple percent delta vs major cloud APIs. Sales will ask for a $/1000 token estimate.
Camille (product): We have bench runs from last week — rough: 40–60% unit-cost reduction at steady 1k req/s when prefix caching is enabled. I'll pull the CSV. Link: https://redwood.internal/bench/1795 (internal)
Diego (sales): Two-sentence field rebut for ops objections: "If you need predictability and isolation, Dedicated capacity with SLA reduces 99p latency variance vs shared serverless endpoints, and gives predictable spend planning." Keep it punchy.
Evan (field): Routing idea for webinar attendees: cold -> automated nurture with benchmark case study; engaged (clicked bench + attended demo) -> SDR + Solutions AE. Scoring rule: clicked bench link OR requested demo -> score +30; webinar Q&A participant -> +50.
Marta (content): I'll write three slide hooks: cost (one stat), reliability (SLA line), rollout (canary + rollback). Need micro-soundbites for SDR email headers.
Ben (growth): Example soundbites: "Serve predictably, ship faster, spend less per useful token." "Stop guessing your token bill — get committed throughput." Short + concrete.
Asha (marketing): OK draft battlecard bullets — please critique:```
Econ-first:
• 40–60% typical unit-cost reduction via caching + batching vs unmanaged endpoints
• Predictable per-token economics with Dedicated and Optimize suggestions
• Bench-backed $/1k-token estimate for common LLM workloads

Ops-first:
• SLA-backed Dedicated capacity reduces tail latency and jitter
• Smart routing + automatic fallback keeps apps online during regional pressure
• Console tracing and token-level cost visibility for debugging
```
Diego (sales): Love the bullets. A couple of nitpicks: swap the order on econ-first to lead with the $/1k estimate, sales tends to ask price first. Also add a one-liner objection response: "What about vendor lock-in?" -> "Models and versions are portable; we support rollouts to multiple model variants and transparent model cataloging."
Camille (product): Adding: quantify fallback — we saw a 3x improvement in successful request rate during induced congestion when using variant fallback. Add that as a quick stat under ops-first.
Evan (field): For routing playbook: set nurture cadence: Day 0: bench email, Day 3: webinar highlights, Day 7: short case study, Day 14: SDR outreach if score > 50. I'll map to HubSpot flows.
Marta (content): I'll produce 2 email subject options per soundbite + 3 short LinkedIn post drafts for the webinar. Need final bullets by EOD.
martech-bot: Registrations update — 72 registered, 18 from target accounts (created 1795556700).
Asha (marketing): Action items: 1) Camille to paste CSV bench & fallback stat (by noon). 2) Marta to draft slide hooks + email subjects (by 3pm). 3) Ben & Diego to finalize $/1k estimate and rebut lines (by EOD). 4) Evan to upload routing rules to HubSpot (tomorrow). I'll stitch the battlecard and put a public draft in #docs when ready. :thumbsup:
Diego (sales): Thanks — will mock a two-sentence opener for outreach and post here when done.
Ben (growth): I'll add a short AB test plan for the webinar CTA copy (cost-first vs reliability-first).
